reasoning: This PR adds a user-configurable `maxBackoff` option to the Retry middleware but changes no documentation. The Retry options table (Configuration Options) and the examples in all five formats do not mention it.
suggested_fix:
Add a row to the Configuration Options table, after `initialInterval`: ```markdown | `maxBackoff` | Upper bound on the wait time between two retries.
If unspecified, the wait time is capped at twice the `initialInterval`.
Defined in seconds or as a valid duration format, see [time.ParseDuration](https://golang.org/pkg/time/#ParseDuration). | 0 | No | ``` Add `maxBackoff: 1s` to the Structured (YAML), Structured (TOML), Labels, Tags, and Kubernetes examples, next to `initialInterval`, so each format produces the same configuration. Before applying: this diff only adds the struct field. `pkg/middlewares/retry/retry.go` does not read `MaxBackoff`, so confirm the behavior and the default before publishing. Also run `make generate` so the generated CRD files pick up the new field; do not edit them by hand.
